description: This Java class represents a Provider entity in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes fields such as provider ID, associated person, identifier, role, speciality, and provider role, along with their getters and setters. The class also contains methods for retrieving the provider's name and string representation, with annotations indicating it is an auditable entity in the system.

classes.name: Provider
classes.description: Represents a healthcare provider linked to a person, with attributes like role, speciality, and identifier, and methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

methods.name: getProviderId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the provider.

methods.name: setProviderId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the provider.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier string for the provider.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the identifier string for the provider.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role concept of the provider.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role concept of the provider.

methods.name: getSpeciality
methods.description: Retrieves the speciality concept of the provider.

methods.name: setSpeciality
methods.description: Sets the speciality concept of the provider.

methods.name: getProviderRole
methods.description: Retrieves the provider's role in the system.

methods.name: setProviderRole
methods.description: Sets the provider's role in the system.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the provider, including provider ID and name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the associated person if available, otherwise null.
